title: Resolve a record by id and reject an unknown id
preconditions: The local app is running against the isolated seeded database.

steps.expected: 200 with the same _id and the record fields.
200 for the legacy id lookup, returning the record whose id is exp_001.
404 with a JSON error body, not an HTML error page.

risk: Read-only. The ObjectId must come from the isolated store, not from a remote cluster.
